blocks.text: MALOLOS, Bulacan—A 17-minute fire broke out at the roof deck of the Malolos City Hall in Bulacan on Friday (October 16) but prompt emergency response immediately quenched the blaze. There was no reported injury or casualty. Reports from the City Information Office said the fire began at 10:58 a.m. It was declared “fire in control” at 11:01 a.m. and “fire out” at 11:15 a.m. The City Hall is a five-storey building situated along the Manila North Road (MacArthur Highway) less than a kilometer after the Bulacan Provincial Capitol.
